data.body_html:
Planning a yacht charter in Marbella in 2037? The minimum age rules are straightforward: you must be 18 to charter a boat without a skipper, and 16 to skipper with a licence. Children of any age are welcome as passengers, though those under 12 must wear life jackets. This guide covers everything you need to know before booking your trip from Puerto Banús.

Minimum Age to Charter a Yacht in Marbella (2037)

Spanish maritime law sets the minimum age for chartering a boat without a skipper at 18. If you hold a valid licence (e.g., Spanish PER, ICC, or equivalent), you can skipper from age 16. All our charters include a licensed skipper, so most guests simply need to be 18. For example, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) departs Puerto Banús at €749/2h – perfect for a family outing.

What If You're Under 18?

If you're 16 or 17, you can still enjoy a skippered charter as a passenger. You just can't book a bareboat (no skipper) charter. Our skippers are licensed professionals who handle all navigation. Boats like the Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) are popular with younger groups – book via WhatsApp for pricing.

Children and Life Jacket Rules

Children under 12 must wear a life jacket at all times while on deck. We provide life jackets in all sizes free of charge. For infants, notify us 48 hours in advance so we can source appropriate gear. Larger boats like the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) from €4,719/4h offer plenty of space for families.

Jet Ski and Water Toy Age Limits

Jet skis require a licence for anyone born after 2009 (minimum age 16). On our Mangusta 80 charter, a jet ski is included free, but only licensed guests can ride it. Water toys like paddleboards have no age limit. For other boats, pricing is available on request via WhatsApp.

Documents You'll Need

Bring a valid passport or national ID card. If you plan to skipper, bring your licence (Spanish PER, ICC, or equivalent). We verify age and licences at check-in at Puerto Banús. No need for additional paperwork – we handle all safety equipment and insurance.

Family-Friendly Charters from Puerto Banús

All ages are welcome as passengers. Our Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) from €749/2h are ideal for families. For larger groups, the Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) offers luxury space. Children under 12 must wear life jackets. There is no minimum age for infants – book your trip today.

Book Your Marbella Yacht Charter

Ready to set sail? Browse our full fleet and choose your boat. All charters include licensed skipper, fuel, drinks (water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava), light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). Contact us via WhatsApp for availability and pricing on any boat not listed in Tier A or Tier B.
